description: Telraam is a dataset listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Telraam. Telraam crée des réseaux personnalisés de capteurs qui exploitent les connaissances et l'accès des résidents locaux, en utilisant la technologie de l'intelligence artificielle (IA) pour fournir des données cohérentes, opportunes et de qualité pour des plans d'infrastructure, de flux de trafic et de gestion du trafic plus efficients et efficaces. Coverage: Wallonia and Brussels. The portal files it under Mobilité. Its keywords are vélo, traffic, voitur. The portal shows 3,535 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY-NC 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/legalcode). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
